unsupervised_ranking_target_sessions.description: CURSOR ranks 60 random candidate face hypotheses for an unknown mental target using unlabeled EEG-response/stimulus pairs. Paper reference is the full windowed-EEG ranking task in Table 1; this environment evaluates the same quantities on a smaller generated-candidate subset.

score_distance_pearson_r.description: Mean Pearson correlation between candidate scores and true target distance; useful rankings should assign higher scores to nearer candidates.

target_rank.description: Mean rank position of the exact target candidate among the 60 hypotheses.

top_rank_distance.description: Mean Euclidean distance from the top-scored candidate to the true target embedding.

target_top1_accuracy.description: Fraction of runs where the exact target candidate is ranked first.

target_top5_accuracy.description: Fraction of runs where the exact target candidate appears within the top five ranked hypotheses.

reciprocal_target_rank.description: Mean reciprocal rank of the exact target candidate, rewarding improvements near the top of the ranking.

near_target_top_rank_rate.description: Fraction of runs where the top-scored candidate is within distance 5.0 of the target embedding.

control_gap_top_rank_distance.description: Distance improvement of the method's top-ranked candidate over the best broken-control top-ranked candidate.

label_supervision_count.description: Audit count of target-label supervision used by the method; the self-calibrating claim requires this to remain zero.

pretrained_decoder_count.description: Audit count of pretrained EEG decoders used by the method; the self-calibrating claim requires this to remain zero.

unsupervised_ranking_eegnet.description: CURSOR ranks 60 random candidate face hypotheses using the released EEGNet embedding representation instead of windowed raw EEG. Paper reference is Appendix Table 2 EEGNet columns.
